profiles.name: Abdelrahman Essam
profiles.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
profiles.summary: Senior Software Engineer with experience in Functional Safety Embedded Software Engineering, hardware design, and embedded systems development. Proficient in Embedded C, C++, Python, and TCL, with expertise in microcontroller architectures, IoT platforms, hardware design, and software development for automotive, robotics, aerospace, railway, and agriculture applications.

profiles.name: Ahmed Mohamed
profiles.title: English & Islamic English Tutor
profiles.summary: I am an English tutor with five years of experience helping children, teenagers, and adults improve their English communication skills. I focus on practical speaking, vocabulary, and confidence-building activities. I also enjoy teaching English through Islamic topics and everyday situations.

profiles.name: Mohamed Ahmed Hassan
profiles.title: Qur'an and Islamic Studies Teacher
profiles.summary: I am an experienced Qur’an and Islamic Studies teacher with over two years of experience teaching non-Arabic-speaking Muslims in English. I have worked with several well-established academies, including Makkah Academy, Super Muslim Academy, Ruwaq Al-Quran Academy, Bedaya Academy, and Noor Al-Quran Academy, in addition to providing private lessons. I specialize in teaching Qur’an, Tajweed, Tafsir, and Islamic Studies. My lessons are engaging, structured, and tailored to each student’s level, helping them learn confidently while developing a strong connection with their faith.
